rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: On 19 September 2005 the National Executive Committee amended the PED regulation: instead of taking office at the opening of the National Meeting planned for early December, the new national leadership would be installed at a National Directorate meeting convened for the weekend after the proclamation of the results, which would give them posse or set its date.
